articles.title: NASA Is Hiring Astronauts — Could You Be Next?
articles.summary: NASA is hiring new astronauts for Moon and Mars trips. Applicants need a science or math master's degree, three years of work experience, and a passed health test — and applications close December 3, 2026.

articles.title: Thanksgiving Traditions: Turkey, Races, and Football
articles.summary: Thanksgiving is full of fun traditions — roast turkey, morning races, a turkey pardon, and football — and this year it falls on November 26.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo Shares a Sad Christmas Song
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo releases her sad Christmas ballad 'Miss This Christmas' on Amazon Music, the flip side of her happy first Christmas song.
